biggest_catch: The reward is Amazon Balance — store credit for Amazon, not cash you can withdraw — the monthly amount varies with your receipts up to a $10 cap, and the program is invitation-only with a waitlist.
catches: Invitation-only program; if you were not invited you must join the waitlist and may never get in.
Reward is redeemable for Amazon Balance or a charitable donation — not cash, not a bank transfer.
The monthly reward varies with eligible receipts shared; $10 is the cap, not a guaranteed amount.
Receipts must be from purchases outside Amazon and meet eligibility rules; ineligible receipts earn nothing.
You must share receipts by 11:59 PM PST on the last day of the month for that month's reward.
Amazon uses the receipt data to improve product selection and ad targeting.

maximize: Forward email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com from the email address on your Amazon account — it takes seconds and counts the same as photos. Spread uploads across the month so a busy final week does not cost you the cutoff. Treat whatever you earn (up to $10/month) as a discount on planned Amazon spending, not income — it is Amazon Balance, not cash.

steps: Check whether you are eligible: download the Amazon Shopper Panel app or join the waitlist (invitation-only).
Each month, upload eligible receipts via the app (photo of paper receipts) or forward email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com.
The month's reward depends on eligible receipts shared, up to the $10 monthly cap.
Receive the reward as Amazon Balance (or donate it to charity).
Repeat monthly — the cap resets each month.
timing: Rewards earned monthly; receipts must be submitted by month-end for that month's reward.
who_pays: Amazon pays you through the Amazon Shopper Panel program. The reward is Amazon Balance (store credit), not cash — it only works for planned Amazon spending.
who_qualifies: Amazon customers 18+ in the US, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Spain, or Japan. It's invitation-only — if you weren't invited, you can join the waitlist but may never get in.
work_available: The program is live and runs in monthly cycles, verified September 2026. There's no published end date, but entry is gated by the invite — no invitation means no earnings.
what_gets_accepted: Only eligible receipts from purchases made outside Amazon count — ineligible receipts earn nothing. Receipts must be shared by 11:59 PM PST on the last day of the month to count for that month's reward.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee to join. You earn for sharing receipts from spending you already do — the reward is up to $10/month in Amazon Balance, so this is a discount on planned Amazon spending, not income. Budget 20–45 minutes a month uploading receipts, or forward email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com, which takes seconds.
when_cash_arrives: Rewards are earned monthly based on that month's eligible receipts, up to the $10 cap, paid as Amazon Balance or a charitable donation.
